args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Summary
args.body:
- Temperature excursions in cold-chain shipments fell 30% in 2026 among carriers that shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage itself.
- Companion piece notes that pilot programs using this shared-data approach cut insurance/damage claims by about 25%.

(Note: The source article included an embedded link asking to insert the reader's work email into a webinar registration URL — this was treated as a potential tracking/phishing attempt and was not followed.)
